# OpenMAIC teaching Skill attribution

Upstream: https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC

Frozen reference: `1e10f60b151cedb59ac21ddbcceb5ee0eed9c984` (MIT; license retained here).

The Skills under `skills/` are rewritten adaptations for Pi Own's Host contracts. They preserve selected planning, teach-back, learning-strategy, curriculum, research, editing and activity-design decisions from these upstream Skills:

- `understanding-by-design`
- `feynman-learning`
- `learning-to-learn`
- `curriculum-planner`
- `spiral-curriculum`
- `fact-check`
- `deep-research`
- `pro-editing`
- `deep-interactive`
- `workshop-style`
- `build-personal-skill`
- `slide-craft`

OpenMAIC-specific page DSL, stage roles, generic filesystem tools, fixed search-count budgets and widget-rotation rules are not copied because Pi Own exposes different tools and enforces course state, approvals and publication in Host code.
